summary: Summit Point's 1949 timber tower with an L-4 cab sits in Wallowa-Whitman NF; staffed in summers as of 2013, and a 2023 report calls it active and standing.

facts.design: 20-foot open timber tower with 14 by 14 foot L-4 cab
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

access.note: A 2013 visitor report says the spur road was closed to traffic and gated that year; the lookout is reached on foot from the trailhead. No source read says whether the public may enter the cab.

visit.trail_note: A 2013 visit describes about a mile's walk from the trailhead. A 2023 trip report reaches the trailhead over forest roads NF-77 and NF-7715.

events.note: Built to replace an earlier open platform tower (used from the 1930s, per firelookout.com). A September 1949 newspaper item says it was complete except for painting.
Oregon Lookouts lists a 20-foot treated timber tower with an L-4 model 1936 cab as erected in 1951. This conflicts with the 1949 completion.
Galen West was due up at the lookout for the summer; an August 27 item said Terry Speelman of Richland would replace him.
Ronalee Leckenby is listed as lookout personnel for 1988-1989 and 1993-1995, per firelookout.com.
firelookout.com lists 1996 and 1999 as not staffed.
A woman in the lookout said the spur road was gated that year because people were driving up at night.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register on July 6, 2022 as US 1642.
A September 2023 trip report describes the lookout as active and currently standing.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register, firelookout.com and the September 1949 newspaper item all date the tower to 1949. Oregon Lookouts lists a 1951 erection of a tower with an L-4 model 1936 cab. The record keeps 1949 as the build year and notes the 1951 entry.
The Register gives 7,014 ft (2,138 m). firelookout.com and Cheryl Hill give 7,006 ft. The record uses the Register figure, which matches the brief.

notes_for_editor: Staffing is only documented through 2013 (Cheryl Hill, dated) and undated firelookout.com; the 2023 trip report calls the lookout active and standing but does not say whether it is staffed. Access is from a 2013 gate report, not checked since. No fire incidents appear in any source read. The 1951 Oregon Lookouts entry conflicts with the 1949 build date and is recorded as a conflict rather than corrected. The brief's record (1949 built, 2022 NHLR registration, 20 ft, 2,138 m, USFS Wallowa-Whitman) matches the Register, so no corrections. No photos added: the Register and firelookout.com credit photos but give no image URLs that were read.
